summary: Comprehensive testing of NexaClinq prescription module revealed critical patient creation database issue that blocks full E2E workflow testing. Patient forms fill correctly but data is not persisted to RxDB, preventing access to prescription module.

ui_bugs.issue: Patient data not persisting to RxDB database after form submission - form accepts input and submits successfully but patients don't appear in patient list
ui_bugs.selector: input[placeholder='Digite o nome do paciente'], input[placeholder='Ex: 15.5'], button[type='submit']

ui_bugs.issue: Prescription module requires valid patient ID from database to load - direct navigation to /#/prescription/test shows blank page without prescription components

integration_issues.issue: Cannot test end-to-end prescription flow (patient creation → Iniciar Atendimento → Nova Receita → drug selection → save) because patient creation step fails

passed_tests: ✅ VET mode is active and properly configured
✅ Patient creation form UI renders correctly with all required fields
✅ Patient creation form accepts input in name and weight fields
✅ Patient creation form submits without JavaScript errors
✅ Code review shows prescription components (PrescriptionPage.js, DrugSelector.js, drugs_db.js) are properly implemented
✅ Drug database contains required medications (Meloxicam, Dipirona) with correct dosing data
✅ Prescription module components have proper data-testid attributes for testing
✅ App uses HashRouter navigation as specified
